_comment: Local MCP servers run as stdio children of the gateway. Remote entries may use transport:http with a url.
_security: Local scripts are spawned by external-mcp.js and die with the gateway. Facebook Ads stays disabled until credentials are configured.

servers.name: ocr
servers.note: OCR tool — image text extraction via Tesseract.

servers.name: screen-recorder
servers.note: Screen recorder — screenshot + video recording via ffmpeg.

servers.name: tts
servers.note: TTS — text to speech (Edge TTS) + playback via ffplay.

servers.name: facebook-ads
servers.note: Facebook Ads — 29 tools. Needs FB credentials; left disabled until configured.

servers.name: universal-adapter
servers.note: Universal transport adapter — stdio mode. Serves its own 9 sandboxed tools plus tools pulled from the main server.

servers.name: skills
servers.note: ZombieCoder skill library — local skills/skills.db, read-only.
